description: $0.10 once, for 30 days. Use when a Discord or Telegram room you own should get pump.fun and Robinhood Chain alerts posted without running a server. Input: destination (a Discord webhook URL, or telegram:<bot_token>:<chat_id>; any other host is refused before payment), kinds (graduation_odds, ring_flags, graduations, avoid_flips), optional filters. A test message is posted first and the payment settles when it arrives; a failed test is unpaid. Then every 60 s each new item is posted as one plain-text message with its public record and paid card links; at most 20 messages an hour and 200 a day. The destination is stored encrypted and never echoed. Unsubscribe with the link in the answer. To poll from code: launches_since ($0.001).

destination.description: Your room's delivery endpoint: a Discord webhook URL https://discord.com/api/webhooks/<id>/<token>, or telegram:<bot_token>:<chat_id> for a Telegram bot you own. Send it in the POST JSON body or the X-Alert-Destination header: a query string can be recorded by proxies.

kinds.description: One or more of graduation_odds, ring_flags, graduations, avoid_flips.

label.description: optional name printed at the start of every message (letters, digits, spaces and basic punctuation)

max_age_s.description: keep items whose launch was at most this many seconds old when the item was recorded; for graduations the time to graduation (0 = no limit)

min_p_grad.description: graduation_odds and avoid_flips: keep items whose P(true graduation) at publication is at least this (0 = no floor)

pumpfun_only.description: true: leave out the Robinhood Chain kind (ring_flags)

rhc_only.description: true: leave out the pump.fun kinds

name: subscribe_alerts
title: Push pump.fun and Robinhood Chain alerts to Discord or Telegram ($0.10)
